posts.title: CHIEF VINCENT NEMIEBOKA MEETS AMANYANABO AND COUNCIL OF BOLO SE OVER UPCOMING DEVELOPMENT PROJECTS
posts.body:
The Executive Chairman of Ogu/Bolo Local Government Area, Chief Vincent Nemieboka DSSRS JP, today met with the Amanyanabo and Council of Bolo Se to brief them on the commencement of several development projects in Bolo Town.
‎
‎The meeting was convened on behalf of Alabo Boma Iyaye DSSRS, Executive Director, Finance and Administration (EDFA), Niger Delta Development Commission (NDDC), as part of ongoing efforts to facilitate development and improve infrastructure in the community.
‎
[ Photo 2 ]

‎During the meeting, the Chairman informed the traditional institution of the planned commencement of the following projects:
‎
‎1. Renovation of Bolo Health Centre: The Rivers State Primary Health Care Board will undertake the renovation of the health facility to improve healthcare delivery in the community.
‎
‎2. Renovation of Bolo-Kira Link Road: The Niger Delta Development Commission (NDDC) will undertake the renovation of sections of the Bolo-Kira link road, which spans over two kilometres, to improve connectivity and ease the movement of people and goods. Inspection and evaluation has already started. 
‎
‎3. The Ogu/Bolo Local Government Council will commence the renovation of the Amanyanabo’s Palace. The building within the palace of the Amanyanabo of Bolo will be renovated to improve the condition of the traditional institution’s facilities.
‎
‎4. Construction of Internal Roads: The Ogu/Bolo Local Government Council will commence the construction of selected internal roads in Bolo Town to enhance accessibility within the community.
‎
‎In his remarks, the Amanyanabo of Bolo Kingdom, HRH Micha Acheseinimie Frank JP KSC, Bolo Luka VIII, expressed gratitude to Alabo Boma Iyaye and Chief Vincent Nemieboka for their interventions and commitment to the development of Bolo Kingdom.
‎
‎He particularly appreciated their efforts towards improving road infrastructure, facilitating the smooth movement of people and goods, and promoting the overall development of the community.
‎
‎The meeting reaffirmed the importance of collaboration between government institutions, development agencies and traditional leadership in advancing infrastructure development and improving the welfare of the people of Bolo.
‎
‎Media and Communications Unit
‎Ogu/Bolo Local Government Area
